name: Kuze Kazuha
source:
The strongest amateur magic girl――Her target: preparing better meals in the future.

Her preference/special skills: Living in an economical lifestyle.
Her favorite stuffs: Making effort and having guts for her living.
Her dislike stuffs: Giving up. 

[Roughly translated and taken from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=721684]some parts of the character description on Getchu's website[/url].]
